# DefendableCloud

> Cloud receipts for agentic work. DefendableCloud is hosted Proof of Execution: upload the work, run the checks, issue the proof, store the artifact. DefendableOS is the engine; DefendableCloud is the hosted proof vault.

DefendableCloud is operated by Swarm and Bee LLC (DBA Swarm & Bee AI), Florida, D-U-N-S 138652395.

## The core primitive — the Defendable Run

Everything is a Run (an AI agent task, dataset review, compute benchmark, valuation, document check, or business workflow). Every Run has the same shape:

Inputs → Evidence → Execution → Checks → Verdict → Approval → Receipt

A named human approves the final result. The checks inform the decision; a person signs off.

## How it works

1. Create a run — pick the kind of work.
2. Attach evidence — files, notes, URLs, observations, tool outputs, model outputs, benchmark logs.
3. Run verification — schema checks, math checks, evidence checks, policy checks, and human approval gates apply the verdict logic.
4. Issue a receipt — an execution trail, verification receipt, verdict package, and evidence bundle, hashed and timestamped.
5. Store & share — keep it in a private vault, send a client link, or export the proof package as PDF and JSON.

## Three lanes at launch

- Agent Work Receipts — for businesses running AI agents: show what the AI did, what tools it used, what evidence it relied on, and whether the result passed review.
- Dataset Receipts — for dataset owners and buyers: show where a dataset came from, how it was checked, what passed, what failed, and why it is training-grade.
- Compute Receipts — for GPU / server validation and resale: show the machine, the benchmark, the GPU identity, the power state, the performance score, and rental or sale readiness.

## What a run produces

Execution Trail · Verification Receipt · Verdict Package · Evidence Bundle · Hash + Timestamp · Exportable PDF + JSON.

## Who it is for

Teams running AI agents · dataset owners and buyers · compute sellers and MicroScalers — anyone accountable for AI work, data, or compute.

## Status

DefendableCloud is rolling out to early teams. Request access at https://defendablecloud.com/contact.

Security posture: production fail-closed checks, owner/member RBAC, hashed magic-link/API tokens, immutable hash-chained receipts, dataset download quotas, signed URLs, and public receipt redaction.
